input.summary: Ported saxpy.cu to saxpy_sycl.cpp with plain SYCL 2020. It has no dpct headers, helpers or macros. It uses malloc_shared USM, a 1-D range parallel_for and a profiling-enabled in-order queue. Kernel time comes from the kernel event's profiling info. Errors are handled with a sycl::exception catch. It compiles cleanly with icpx -fsycl without the dpct include path. I did not run it or compare its output against the reference. The kernel arithmetic is the same as the CUDA version (y = a*x + y in float32), so I expect it to match within 1e-6.
